composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_2 is on his knees using a sharp dental pick to isolate a flat siltstone block. The fine-grained, chalky sulfur yellow siltstone matrix is being carved away from the hollow, hatchet-shaped crest of a Lambeosaurus skull.
